strings.settings.title: Lilith Mod Settings
strings.settings.language_hint: Follows the game by default. This controls the Mod UI and Lilith's future replies.
strings.settings.api_intro: Enter the details supplied by your model provider or proxy. API keys are stored only on this PC.
strings.settings.api_key: API key (leave blank to keep the saved key)
strings.settings.web_search: Web search method (availability is not guaranteed)
strings.settings.search_key: Brave Search API key (leave blank to keep it)
strings.settings.reply_limit_hint: The model will compose a complete reply within this limit.
strings.settings.parenthetical: Allow parenthetical expressions/actions (DeepSeek models often return them)
strings.settings.dns_fallback: Automatically try backup DNS when a connection fails
strings.settings.dns_fallback_hint: For TLS connection failures on direct official API connections, retry once using Ali DNS and prefer it for 10 minutes after success. Proxy connections use the proxy settings.
strings.settings.proxy_hint: Priority: this value, HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY, then direct connection. localhost and 127.0.0.1 always bypass the proxy.
strings.settings.gemini_notice: Gemini uses store=false, so Google does not host the chat chain. Free-tier input/output may be used to improve services; Google Search grounding data is retained for 30 days under its terms and each model-executed query may be billed. Connection testing does not run Search.
strings.settings.other_intro: Choose the preferred player for “Let's listen together”, adjust chat size, and configure desktop interaction. Other installed players are tried automatically if needed.
strings.settings.chat_scale_hint: The window first scales for screen resolution; this multiplier is applied on top.
strings.settings.cross_screen_hint: Enable Cross-screen Dragging under the game's Settings → Controls first. While dragging, this option temporarily handles native ground segments and restores the target monitor floor on release.
strings.settings.memory_intro: View or edit locally stored long-term player memories. This does not change the character definition or current chat.
strings.settings.memory_edit: Edit Lilith's memories of the player
strings.settings.local_intro: Read-only local context is sent only when a question concerns time, date, music, or playback. Ordinary chats include none of it.
strings.settings.local_enabled: Allow Lilith to read relevant local context
strings.settings.local_time: Local time, date, weekday, and time zone
strings.settings.local_media: Current track, artist, and playback state (music apps only)
strings.settings.local_privacy: Privacy: when enabled, relevant time, track, and artist data may be sent to your configured model or search provider. Raw state is not independently stored in history, long-term memory, or logs. Anything naturally mentioned in a model reply is retained like ordinary chat. Browser video is never read.
strings.settings.support_intro: The Mod is free. If you enjoy it, you may voluntarily buy the author a coffee. Donations never affect features.
strings.settings.saved_restart: Settings saved. Restart the desktop pet to apply them.
strings.settings.memory_editor_rules:
Changing the name also updates the game save and migrates Lilith's long-term memories; no AI is called.
Each row is one memory: category ≤24 characters, content ≤100; at most {0} rows and {1} characters total.
Select full rows and press Delete to remove them. Changes apply from the next turn. Never enter passwords, codes, identity documents, bank-card data, or API keys.

strings.settings.memory_rules_overview:
How to edit safely:
· While the game is running, the in-game player name can be changed at the top of the editor; existing long-term memory is migrated automatically.
· Each row is one memory: category ≤24 characters, content ≤100 characters.
· Up to {0} entries and {1} Unicode characters in total.
· Select complete rows and press Delete to remove them; changes apply from the next reply.
· To migrate devices, copy the entire players folder. Editing and validation are local and never call AI.
· Never enter passwords, verification codes, identity documents, payment-card data, or API keys.
